reason: Verified by pixel-sampling the real composited backdrop at 1440x960, not by reading the token. ?v=paper&state=owner-empty: #b-empty-date::placeholder computes rgba(17,17,17,0.46) at 15px/400 over an opaque white input ground (sampled rgb(255,255,255)) = 3.13:1, exactly as claimed, against a 4.5:1 floor; the same rule on ink is 4.68:1 and legal. The stepper is right in substance but wrong in number: driving the item to its floor in ?v=paper&state=owner-editing yields .b-step[aria-disabled="true"] '-7' at 15px/400 over the .b-edit --fore-06 tint (sampled rgb(241,241,241)), which is 3.06:1, not 3.13:1 - and on ink it is 4.53:1, a hair over the floor, so 0.46 is carrying nothing there either. The self-contradiction is real: b.css:277-279 at .b-behindDate writes the rule ('over ink, 0.46 is 4.65:1 and legal; over paper it is 3.15:1 and is not') and b.css:444 and 464 are the only two places the file then sets type in --fore-46, both of which land on paper. The gate hole is real and I checked both halves rather than taking them on trust: audit.mjs:181 enumerates exactly ['::before','::after'], so ::placeholder is invisible to it at any variant; it only page.goto()s each state (line 255) and never presses anything, and I confirmed .b-step[aria-disabled="true"] count is 0 at load in all eleven paper states, so the disabled stepper does not exist for it to grade. I also ran the audit at --v=paper myself: TOTALS all zero, clean pass - so even closing the variant half of the hole would still miss both defects. interaction-check.mjs opens paper once (583-590) to read one background colour. The placeholder is also the only statement of the expected date format anywhere in owner-empty (the label reads just 'The day'), which is what lifts this above a token nit. The proposed --fore-62 works: measured 5.29:1 on paper / 7.63:1 on ink for the placeholder and 5.07:1 / 7.09:1 for the stepper.
sharpenedFix: Take the CSS as written (b.css:444 and 464 to --fore-62), but correct the record: the stepper failure is 3.06:1 over the --fore-06 edit tint, not 3.13:1 over white, and WCAG exempts inactive controls, so the disabled stepper is a violation of this file's own stated ladder rather than an AA failure - the placeholder is the one that is actually illegal and should not be argued as taste. Fix the gate more cheaply than proposed: add '::placeholder' to the pseudo list at audit.mjs:181 instead of writing a bespoke assertion in interaction-check.mjs - that one-word change makes every input, in every state and every variant, graded by the compositing code the gate already trusts (it is the shared skill script, so the win carries to other labs), and only the driven-disabled case then needs the interaction gate. Add the --v=paper and --v=record audit runs as the finding says. Separately, do not leave the date format living only in a placeholder that vanishes on first keystroke: state it under the label (or seed #b-empty-hint with 'Any format - 3 October 2026, 03/10/2026') so the format survives typing; that is the part of this the contrast fix alone does not solve.
